Hello VOAT!

My name is David M. Citarelli. I am a college student who runs a business with his father. I am currently chasing my bachelors in Business Administration, so that I can take my company to the next level. I am a foreign and domestic investor, with shares in Disney, Apple, Google, and several other major companies. I am also a realist and am not afraid to say what needs to be said.

I'm here, simply because I want my experience on the internet to be pristine. Reddit, currently, is filled with a lot of drama; drama that I hope does not plague VOAT. That being said, in coming to VOAT I have a few suggestions for you guys.

  1. Have a well suited, well versed community team solely dedicated to gathering information from VOAT's user-base and handing it to management, to which they can make informed decisions. I would pick people from the community itself; people who are analytical, well spoken, and informed individuals.

  2. Ensure that management relies solely on community happiness. If a community is happy and want to support you, they'll click on the ads you have on your site or they'll donate to you. Do not force the community to do anything; let it happen on its own. In fact, if there is an uprising, like what's going on in reddit, admit you're wrong and split even with everyone. Having a community that is happy, is also one that will be willing to forgive you if you make a mistake.

  3. Do not monetize anything. I know you guys have mouths to feed at home, but take a piece from reddit; no VOAT gold. As I said above, if you have ads, the user-base will click on them to support you.

That's about it. I hope you gentlemen at VOAT do enjoy your job, because you're gonna be doing it a lot for the next, I'd say, week. Good luck in everything and above all else, if you are unsure of a decision, ask the community. We'll tell you what we want and what we don't want. Our happiness on your site should be your number one priority above everything else, otherwise we'll do to you what we did to reddit, and leave if we are not happy. I don't like saying this, but it's a fact and if this is something you can't handle then back out now and let someone else do the job, because these shoes need to be filled.

Have a wonderful day, gentlemen.

Regards,

David M. Citarelli
